title: HackerRank: Counting Valleys
description: An avid hiker tracks their hike. For every step it was noted if it was an uphill step 'U' or downhill step 'D'. The hike starts and ends at sea level (altitude 0). A valley is a sequence of consecutive steps below sea level, starting with a step down from sea level and ending with a step up to sea level. Given `path`, return the number of valleys walked through.
